summary: Sound stage-1 rewrite aimed at the two shapes furthest from their floors; it fixes both causes REWRITE_READ section 2 found for the gemv loss (a ring that never fills; a global partial store plus a ticket tail that grows with m). Proceed as a check. Before building, correct the incumbent baselines (it quotes the restack's kernels, not master's), and add an smem swizzle and a cluster-residency gate.
justification: o (16.8 MB) and the unpooler slice (8.4 MB) are latency-bound 32-64 KB/CTA streams; issuing each CTA's whole slice at once puts the full weight in flight in one wave, and the DSMEM fixed-order reduce removes the gpu-scope ticket and fp32 global workspace (the m-proportional costs the read measured). Uses only baseline sm_90 (mma.sync, cp.async.cg, cluster launch, mapa, ld.shared::cluster, barrier.cluster); no wgmma. Weak points: (1) M3 needs the slice row at 4.0-4.2 us, but slice rows sit ~1.5 us above kernel time (master 4.5->5.94, restack 4.3->6.2), needing a ~2.5 us cold kernel for 8.4 MB plus cluster fixed cost; M2 credible, M3 on the slice a stretch, o <=5.0 plausible. (2) Baselines: master 8b9ad43 routes o m<=16 to _pooler_skinny_kernel and the slice to _bf16_splitk_kernel split-K 8; run 1602a4e947e64090 has o kernels 4.6/5.2/4.8 rows 6.32/6.32, slice kernels 4.5/4.6 rows 5.94/6.13. The quoted figures come from the restack run 60b20fd0bf924267. Judge M2 against master and also report vs the restack. (3) Bank conflicts: 256 B / 1 KB power-of-two row pitches make unswizzled ldmatrix ~8-way conflicted (~2 us); XOR-swizzle or +16 B pad the cp.async destination and ldmatrix addresses. Cluster residency: o needs 32 co-resident 8-CTA clusters at 2 CTAs/SM, an exact fit on 132 SMs; fall back to cluster dim 4 (64 x 4, K 256/rank) when cudaOccupancyMaxActiveClusters < 32, not straight to master; the slice (16 clusters at 1 CTA/SM) has the same risk. Smem ~80 KB, 2 CTAs/SM fits; alias the fp32 partial onto consumed weight buffer. Judge milestones on rows (warm-L2 caveat).

Sticky-fault risk: a bad mapa rank or out-of-range ld.shared::cluster in the self-check poisons the context; okc check only, plain cp.async.cg, -lineinfo, sync+print after each self-check launch, never launch more clusters than cudaOccupancyMaxActiveClusters.
